content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Scottsdale

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—typically a degree plus years of documented project leadership hours. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can verify your qualifications before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend interactive sessions delivered by active certified practitioners covering all five PMBOK® domains. Flexible scheduling accommodates Scottsdale professionals balancing work and study; you'll earn all required contact hours in one cohesive program.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing bootcamp training, submit your PMP application directly to PMI with proof of education and project experience. Pay PMI's exam fee at application time. Granite PM Academy guides you through the submission process to ensure accuracy and timely approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to solidify your mastery. Schedule your exam at a PMI-authorized testing center on your preferred date. Our support continues through your exam day to maximize confidence and performance.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to PMI's 3-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, and professional engagement. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning resources to help you stay current and renew on schedule.
